scenes.heading: Pricing and packaging brand identity projects

sents.d: Pricing and packaging brand identity projects
Bundling related deliverables into tiers simplifies client decisions.

scenes.heading: Identity is more than a logo

sents.d: A full brand identity project typically includes more than just a logo — brand strategy or positioning, a logo and its variations, a color palette, typography choices, and basic brand guidelines documenting how to use them.
Packaging these into tiers (e.g. a logo-only package, a mid-tier identity package, and a full brand system package) gives clients a clear choice rather than negotiating every element individually.

Brand identity work generally commands higher prices than single-piece design work because of its scope and long-term impact on the client's business — pricing it as a smaller add-on to a logo undervalues the strategic thinking involved.

take: Sell brand identity in clear tiers, priced for its impact.
